justification: Both scenes include a human figure, but in A it is a naturalistically modeled, reclining figure beneath carved hieroglyphic blocks, while in B the figures are small schematic silhouettes accompanying numerous boat-like, ladder-rung motifs that have no counterpart in A. The dominant motifs (glyph columns in A, boat/comb shapes in B) are entirely different, so beyond the generic presence of a person there is no specific iconographic correspondence.
